steps.text: Combustion is burning a fuel in oxygen to release heat and light. Different materials burn differently — let's compare.
Pick a material to burn — tap one from the list.
Now burn it and watch: paper catches fast, while some materials burn slower or hotter.
Every case follows the same rule: Fuel + Oxygen → Products + Heat + Light. That's combustion.

coach.mission: Burn different materials and compare how each one combusts.
whenStuck: Select a material first, then burn it.
Compare how fast and how hot each material burns.
whenWrong: They all need fuel and oxygen — but the speed and heat differ.
Combustion always gives heat and light plus new products.
whenCorrect: Right — that material burned in oxygen, releasing heat and light.
Good — different fuels burn at different rates.
coach.done: You've compared how materials combust. Try more, or move on when you're ready.
